captions_meta.hook: MSMEs made up 39.7% of Malaysia's GDP in 2025. How many made the news? 🤔
lines: • And 96.1% of all establishments (OECD, citing DOSM 2024)
New outlets, first exports, 50 new hires: these are local news stories.
They just rarely get written in a format newsrooms can use.
captions_meta.li_hook:
Malaysian MSMEs contributed 39.7% of GDP in 2025 and account for 96.1% of business establishments.
Their share of business headlines is far smaller.
li_body: DOSM's latest MSME release usually gets read as an economic indicator. We read it as a communications gap: hundreds of thousands of businesses with stories that never reach a journalist.

Not because they aren't newsworthy, but because they aren't packaged as news. A third outlet, a first export contract or 50 new hires is a strong local story when it comes with clear numbers and a quotable spokesperson.
captions_meta.li_close: If you run an SME: which story from this year should the public know about?
captions_meta.fb: Fun fact: MSMEs made up 39.7% of Malaysia's GDP in 2025. If your business is one of them, your story deserves coverage too 💙
